reason: I already installed Khatabook once and stopped updating it, so why would this be different? Half my orders come by phone call and this misses them, and I keep stock in my head anyway.
objection: Half my orders come by call, so it misses them. Recording every call sounds like extra work, and if I will not keep entering things it will go the way of the ledger app.
would_change_my_mind: If it picked up my phone-call orders by itself without me recording anything, and the person who sets it up stayed with me for a couple of weeks until it was part of my routine.
